prerequisites.reason: Probability distributions are functions describing likelihoods over outcomes.
Distributions describe the behavior of random variables.
Covariance is defined between two random variables.
Computing covariance requires understanding distributions and expected values.
Core information-theoretic quantities such as entropy are defined using probability distributions.
Statistical inference relies on probability distributions to model samples and uncertainty.
Probabilistic models represent uncertainty using probability distributions.
Probabilistic models are built around random variables and their dependencies.
Neural networks are composed of mathematical functions mapping inputs to outputs.
